tasks.answer: 特殊旅客/旅客预订详情页：导出名 TravelerBookingDetailScreen，导入路径 @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen，必填 props：bookId（string）。该页含状态流转、评价与媒体，需 query 与 router provider，操作按权限门控。
底部弹出层：导出名 UiPopup，导入路径 @/components/ui/overlay（与 UiActionSheet 同 barrel）。必填 props 仅 onClose；open 默认 false，position 默认 bottom，safeArea 默认 false，含遮罩与滚动/安全区处理。
登录页：SignInPage，@/features/auth/sign-in-page（密码/SMS 双 tab、验证码、redirect 可选，需 router/auth store/i18n）。顶部导航栏：UiNavBar，@/components/ui/navigation（back/left/right 动作，无需必填 props，fixed 可选）。
航班延误补偿列表页：导出名 FlightDelayCompensationListScreen，导入路径 @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen，必填 props：context 与 onContextChange。含延误事件/结算批次筛选与 tab，仅在有查询权限时启用查询。
图片查看器：导出名 UiImageViewer，导入路径 @/components/ui/image-viewer，必填 props：image、open、onClose；关闭状态渲染 null。

notes: 5 tasks => 5 searches (one each), no get, no second search; all results from catalog57 single search with --per-layer 3. B1 ranked TravelerBookingDetailScreen #1 for 'special passenger booking detail'; catalog has no component id containing 'special-passenger' in the returned set, so it is reported as the traveler booking detail page (medium confidence on 特殊旅客 mapping). B3 satisfied by one combined query returning both SignInPage and UiNavBar. Protocol deviation: one initial `ls -la` of the project root was run before searching (no catalog/config/source file was read); no other ls/cat/grep/help used. usage.jsonl holds the 5 search log lines.
